Start with free coins. Keep your account with a verified email. Choose a coin pack or an annual pass when you want more.

How coins work

  • Your first guest wallet starts with 5 free coins. Refreshing does not refill it.
  • A new game or restart costs 1 coin. Opening a cabinet, pausing and resuming are free. A volleyball match ends at 15 points; 2048 can continue after reaching 2048.
  • Sign in with the emailed code to save your wallet across devices. Unspent guest welcome coins transfer once; signing in does not refill coins you have already used.
  • Verified accounts can claim 10 free coins once per Los Angeles calendar day.
  • Scores and preferences are saved in your browser. Clearing browser storage can lose guest access; use email sign-in before clearing it.

Payment and delivery

  1. Verify your email in the NanoFun wallet before buying.
  2. Use the same email at Stripe checkout. Your bank statement may show PromptKami; the product is NanoFun Games.
  3. After successful payment, return to NanoFun. The server verifies the order before granting coins or VIP.
  4. A purchase confirmation identifying your product, amount and entitlement is sent to the purchase email after verification. Check spam if needed.

If you close checkout before returning, sign in again and choose Restore purchases. Background reconciliation normally checks orders every five minutes; provider delays can take longer. An open payment page or success URL alone does not grant credit. Do not pay again just because delivery is delayed.

Manage or cancel annual renewal

Contact us from your purchase email with your order reference to request cancellation or help managing a subscription. Use the link below or the renewal-management link in your NanoFun wallet. We handle the request with the payment provider; sending an email is a request, not an instant cancellation confirmation.

After future renewal is canceled, your already-paid period remains available through its expiry, subject to later refunds or payment disputes. The wallet shows your current verified expiry. Existing subscriptions are blocked from starting a second annual subscription; contact support if you need to resume or change one.

Request renewal or cancellation help ↗

Missing delivery, duplicate payments or refund requests

Email superpowergames.us@gmail.com with the purchase email, product and order reference from your confirmation. We will investigate with Stripe. Never send a password, full card number, security code or sign-in code.

Refunds or payment disputes can reduce coins or end VIP access. If refunded coins were already used, future coin credits may offset the adjustment; the displayed balance never becomes a cash debt. Any rights you have under applicable consumer law remain unaffected.

Rewarded ads

Google advertising approval is pending. No rewarded ads are currently played, and no reward is granted for a placeholder, skipped ad or unavailable inventory. The planned option is voluntary: complete an eligible rewarded ad for 3 coins, up to 8 times daily, once the provider and reward verification are ready. Daily free coins and paid options do not require watching an ad.

Need a hand with controls?

2048 supports swipes, arrow keys and WASD. Snake supports swipes, directional buttons and keyboard controls. Volleyball supports keyboard and on-screen touch controls; local two-player mode uses landscape orientation. Leaving a cabinet ends that run. Check the controls shown inside each cabinet.
